data.one_liner: Comprehensive string manipulation library supporting Latin, non-Latin, and grapheme clusters.
data.what_it_does: Provides advanced string operations including case conversion, unicode handling, truncation, slugification, and HTML escaping. It handles grapheme clusters and diacritics correctly using regex-based word detection.
use_when: You need complex string operations like case conversions, slugification, or latinization.
Your app works with non-Latin scripts, emojis, or grapheme clusters where standard Dart string methods fall short.
avoid_when: You only need basic built-in Dart string operations.
You require localized plural rules or heavy internationalization formatting.
strengths: Full Unicode and grapheme cluster support
Smart word detection using regex patterns instead of simple whitespace splitting
weaknesses: Does not provide localization or translation features
Some legacy methods are deprecated in version 1.2.0
